info.title: cancho-studio
info.description: A local web app for image-edit and video jobs (docs/studio.md). It listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Every request needs the token the server prints at start, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or the cookie `studio`, a `Host` of 127.0.0.1:<port> or localhost:<port>, and, when there is an `Origin`, the same host with `http://`. A POST must be application/json.

get.summary: The page (the cancho-ui build), or a stub without a site directory. With a valid `?token=` it answers 302 / and sets the cookie.

302.description: Token accepted: Location / and Set-Cookie studio=<token>; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/

get.summary: The page's script, from the site directory.
A form (HTML, no JavaScript) to edit a picture chosen in the browser.

post.summary: Queue an edit of an uploaded picture: the picture is kept as <data>/upload-N.jpg, .png or .webp (by its first bytes) and a job is made as POST /api/jobs makes it. The one POST that is not JSON.

seed.description: An integer from 0 to 2147483647, or empty.

image2.description: Optional: a second picture to combine with the first (JPEG, PNG or WebP; an empty file field is none).

condition_area.description: With image2: the pixels each picture is resized to, 65536 to 1048576.

variations.description: 1 to 8; more than 1 makes a set and goes to /sets/{id}.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 16 MiB for the whole request.

302.description: Queued: Location /jobs/N; /compare/N for a pair (rewrite ab); /sets/N for variations.

500.description: The queue could not be read or the picture could not be saved.

get.summary: The comparisons: the tally per kind of the choices that count (the rewritten prompt won, the prompt as written won, ties) and a link to each pair.

A pair (made by `rewrite: ab`): the two results as left and right, without saying which used the rewritten prompt; a form to choose once both have finished; after the choice, which was which and both prompts. Blind by convention: the job ids are in the page source.

422.description: The id is not 1 to 9 digits (plain text).

post.summary: Record the choice, once: `choice=left`, `choice=right` or `choice=tie` (an HTML form, `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`: the one POST besides /edit that is not JSON).

409.description: A choice was already made, or the two jobs have not both finished.

422.description: The body is not one of the three choices.

500.description: The choice could not be written.

get.summary: This document, from the site directory.
The models each kind of job can use.

200.description: A list per kind; `image` is empty (text to image is not wired).

get.summary: The 50 newest jobs, newest first, with the counts the header shows: running and queued among the 200 newest. `kind` is the first entry of the job's argument list, `prompt` the last (as written; a control character is a space).

post.summary: Queue a job: writes <data>/N.argv and a line in <data>/queue; the worker runs it.

500.description: The queue could not be read.

200.description: `state` is queued, running, done, or `failed C` (C the exit code; 255 for a job a dead worker left running).

422.description: The id is not 1 to 9 digits.

get.summary: The stylesheet of the pages the server writes (/jobs, /jobs/{id}, /sets/{id}, /compare, /edit): light and dark by the browser's setting, no script.
A set of variations (made by `variations`): the results of its jobs side by side, each with its seed and state; refreshes every 5 s while a job is queued or running. The id is the set's first job.

422.description: The id is not 1 to 9 digits (plain text).

get.summary: The jobs, newest first (200 at most), as an HTML list.
A job's page: state, the result when done, the log. Refreshes itself while queued or running.

404.description: No such job (plain text in an HTML answer).

422.description: The id is not 1 to 9 digits.

get.summary: A file of a job, from a closed list of names, streamed in pieces. `Range: bytes=a-b`, `a-` and `-n` are answered 206; several ranges, another unit or a malformed value are ignored (200, the whole file).

206.description: The bytes asked for; `Content-Range: bytes a-b/size`.

404.description: A name not on the list, or the file is not there (plain text).

416.description: The range starts past the end; `Content-Range: bytes */size`.

422.description: The id is not 1 to 9 digits (plain text).

503.description: Eight files are already being sent; `Retry-After: 1`.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or a wrong one.

Forbidden.description: A Host or Origin that is not this server's own.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: A POST that is not application/json.

Refused.description: What the server refuses to queue; `error` says which field.

kind.description: `image` is text to image from a prompt (`media image`): `size` WxH up to 1024 x 1024 (a multiple of 32), `seed`, `steps`, `model`; no `image` path, no `frames`, no `fps`. The result is `image.png`.

prompt.description: 1 to 1000 bytes; a NUL is refused.

image.description: Required for an edit: the absolute path of a file on the server's machine, 2 to 400 bytes.

rewrite.description: Rewrite the prompt first with a local model. The worker must have been started with --rewriter. Absent: the server's default, which is off unless it was started with --rewrite on. `ab` makes a pair of jobs (the same request with the rewrite off and on) for the blind comparison at /compare/{id}; the answer is {"id":N,"pair":M}.

also.description: An edit only (422 otherwise): the absolute path of a second picture on the server's machine to combine with `image` (`media edit --also`); the instruction can refer to both. Two pictures is the case measured.

condition_area.description: With `also` only: the pixels each picture is resized to (default 589824 = 768 x 768; 1048576 = 1024 x 1024 is the largest measured).

steps.description: An edit only (422 for a video): the denoising steps, `media edit --steps` (the model's default is 8).

fps.description: A video only (422 for an edit): frames a second of the file, `media video --fps` (default 16).

model.description: A model name from /api/models, `media --model`; media refuses one it does not know (the job fails with its log).

variations.description: Make this many jobs of the same request, with the seeds seed, seed+1, ... (seed defaults to 1 here), shown together at /sets/{id}; the answer is {"id":F,"ids":[...],"set":"/sets/F"}. Exclusive with rewrite ab. Absent: one job. The jobs run one after another, so the time is that many times one job's.

ids.description: With variations: every job of the set, in order.

set.description: With variations: the path of the set's page.
